whatThisTeaches: one human action followed by actorless automatic procedures
seeded hidden-deck randomness and countdown pressure
state-derived action availability and ordered public events
whenToCopyThisPattern: Use this pattern for a solo puzzle where one human decision triggers deterministic automatic consequences.
Keep hidden deck order private while exposing enough public event history to explain each consequence.
Model distinct countdown and damage loss reasons explicitly so complete scenarios can prove every terminal branch.
